name: ai-workflow-fe
$comment: This file is copied into each consuming project as standards/standards.json.
It is how the standards sync detects which version a project is running and
whether local edits have diverged from source.
BUMP THE VERSION ON EVERY material distributed change: standards, workflows,
adapters, manifests, templates, installer, validator, or enforcement hooks.
major - a rule was removed, inverted, or a layer restructured.
minor - a rule or reference file was added.

toolAgnostic.$comment: standards/ is tool-neutral; workflow bodies are portable while frontmatter may be adapter-oriented.
toolAgnostic.enforcement: enforcement/ — git hooks and local checks

changelog.1.1.0: Separated executable validation commands from agent-editable project policy, added guarded execution configuration and safe legacy migration, expanded installer/sync/uninstall safety coverage, and introduced opt-in Figma and Jira capabilities with design-to-code and ticket-to-code workflows.
